summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is for ordering a Rice Bowl from a food delivery or restaurant app. The main contents and functions include:

1. **Title**: "RICE BOWL" at the top of the screen.
2. **Image**: A picture of a rice bowl dish with various ingredients.
3. **Description**: Text describing the dish as "100% basmati rice, choice of chicken, beef & lamb, turkey & mushroom meatball, falafel or veggies."
4. **Protein Selection**: A section titled "PICK YOUR PROTEIN" where users can select one protein option from the following:
   - Beef & Lamb ($8.45)
   - Turkey & Mushroom Meatball ($7.95)
   - Chicken ($7.95)
   - Falafel ($7.45)
   - Veggie ($7.45)
5. **Add to Order Button**: A red button at the bottom labeled "Add To Order ($8.45)"
